takeaway: Ulcerative colitis predisposes to colon adenocarcinoma and bile duct carcinoma, not anal squamous cell carcinoma.

question.text: Which premalignant condition is incorrectly matched with its associated malignant tumour?
question.say: Which premalignant condition is incorrectly matched with its associated malignant tumour?

answer.text: Ulcerative colitis – squamous cell carcinoma of the anus

lines.text: Look at the picture: one premalignant condition is paired with the wrong tumour.
Ulcerative colitis ulcerates the colon wall, and that raises the risk of cancer.
The tumours it really predisposes to are adenocarcinoma of the colon, and carcinoma of the bile duct.
Anal squamous cell carcinoma is not one of them, so this is the incorrect match.
The other four pairings in the list are the correct ones.
Remember it as colon and bile duct, never the anus. Done!
